main_text.p: דָּג , דָּגָה דָּאג דָּג Piscis : plur. דָּגִים .
דָּגָה דָּג m. Piscator : plur. דָּגִים & דָּגִים .
דּוֹד m. Dilectus, Amicus: Patruus: plurale, דּוֹדִים Amici: Amores.
דּוּד m. Canistrum, Sporta: Lebes, Pelvis: plur. דּוּדִים , דּוּדִים, & semel דּוּדָאִים cum epen-thesi א. Item דּוּדָאִים Mandragora.
דּוָה דּוָה m. Languidus: fem. דָּוָה Languida; Debilis. דָּוִי m. idem.
מַדְוֶה דּוּת דּוֹי m. Languor, Debilitas.
דּוּחַ Hiphil הֵדִיחַ Dispulit, Depulit: Abluit.
דּוּכִיפַת f. Gallus sylvestris, vel Attagen.
דּוּם Siluit, Obmutuit, Quievit. Pihel דּוֹמֵם Silere fecit, Sedavit.
דָּם m: Quies, juxta quosdam, Ezech. 19. 10: vide דְּמָה .
דִּין Judicare, Disceptare. jus dicere. Chald. Part. דַּיָּן Judicantes, Causam cognoscentes. Niphal נִדּוֹן judicari, judicare apud se. Hiphil הִדִּין Judicare.

page.notes: The Hebrew forms are copied from the scan and are uncertain in their vowel points and final letters; the running head and the Hebrew headwords were not checked letter by letter. The rendering of some Hebrew words (e.g. the Pihel and Niphal forms) may contain errors and should be checked against the original.
